steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8090/ and sign in with username 'admin' and password 'bench-admin-pass'. After signing in, navigate to the project named 'Bench Project' and open its work packages list. Report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed on the page. Do not modify any work package.

02-create: In the project 'Bench Project' at http://127.0.0.1:8090, create a new work package of type 'Task' with subject exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that contains the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench work package for run {{runid}}'). Save it. Then report the numeric work package ID exactly as the app displays it (OpenProject shows it as #<number>), and confirm the subject and type shown on the new work package's page. Do not modify any work package whose subject starts with 'Seed:'.

03-open: Open the work package with ID {{02-create.displayed_id}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project 'Bench Project' at http://127.0.0.1:8090. On its details page, make three in-place edits (fields become editable when clicked and save automatically, there is no overall Save button): 1) Set the 'Assignee' field to the user named 'Bench Assignee' — this is an autocomplete, so type the name and actually select the matching option from the dropdown that appears; the value only counts once the option is chosen. 2) Set the 'Status' field to 'In progress'. 3) Set the 'Finish date' field to 2026-12-31. After all three edits, reload/verify the page and report the exact values displayed for Assignee, Status, and Finish date. Do not modify any work package whose subject starts with 'Seed:'.

04-open: Open the work package with ID {{02-create.displayed_id}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project 'Bench Project' at http://127.0.0.1:8090. On its details page, find the comments/activity area, add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'), and submit/save it. Then verify the comment appears in the work package's activity/comments list and report the exact comment text displayed. Do not modify any work package whose subject starts with 'Seed:'.

05-open: Final verification, read-only, do not modify anything. At http://127.0.0.1:8090: 1) Open work package {{02-create.displayed_id}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project 'Bench Project' and report exactly what the page displays for: the work package ID (as #<number>), type, subject, description text, assignee, status, and finish date. 2) Also confirm a comment containing '{{runid}}' is visible in its activity/comments. 3) Then open the 'Bench Project' work packages list and report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:'. Report all values exactly as displayed.
